transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Back in 2025 I spent a few days in Chengdu and basically just wandered around checking out attractions whenever I had time.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Around that same stretch, I remember my coworker was doing the Beijing to Shanghai run by train a lot for work.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: And then in April 2025 I was down in Guangzhou for a thing, so I ended up thinking way too much about where people usually stay there.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: For Chengdu, I actually went to Du Fu Thatched Cottage on 2025-05-27, and I picked a morning slot since afternoons were always getting hectic.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: The ticket was just for me—1 person—and it was under my name, Sarah Chen.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: My friend Xie Peng told me he’d already ridden train G1 on 2025-03-03, and he said Second Class was totally fine for that ride.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: For Guangzhou, Emily Wang had everything set up already—she stayed at Hanting Hotel Tianhe, checked in on 2025-04-18, and it was 4 nights.
